about.title: About H Biomed Services
paragraphs: H Biomed Services is a dealer in new and refurbished medical equipment, accessories, hospital furniture and medical gas pipeline systems, based in Hyderabad.
We also provide installation, servicing, repair and maintenance, so one supplier can look after your equipment from purchase onwards.
